high_level_description: This image depicts a nighttime scene featuring a road sign with directions to various towns in Tamil Nadu, India. The sign is illuminated, making the text and arrows clearly visible against the dark background. The text on the sign includes: மதுரை (Madurai) திருச்சி (Tiruchi) வில்லுப்புரம் (Villupuram) திண்டுவனம் (Tindivanam) செங்கல்பட்டு
